data.name: Adamancipator Conductor
data.desc: If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other "Adamancipator" card from your hand on top of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 4 or lower Rock monster, also place the rest on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Conductor" once per turn.

data.name: Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite
data.desc: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Adamancipator" card: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite", then you can Special Summon 1 Rock monster from your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Rock Synchro Monster in your field or GY; return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, place this card on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite" once per turn.

data.name: Adamancipator Luminous
data.desc:
2 Effect Monsters, including a Synchro Monster
If this card is Link Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to: You can target 1 monster in your face-up field or GY; Special Summon 1 "Dwimmered Stone Token" (Rock/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as that monster. When an effect of another monster on the field is activated (Quick Effect): You can place that monster on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Luminous" once per turn.

data.name: Adamancipator Mates
data.desc: Add 1 "Adamancipator" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Mates" once per turn.

data.name: Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite
data.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If you have a DARK monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can return cards your opponent controls to the hand, up to the number of excavated Rock monsters, also place the excavated cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite" once per turn.

data.name: Advent of Atlantis
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "Advent of Atlantis" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can place 1 "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" or "Umi" from your Deck, face-up in your Field Zone. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand.
data.archetype: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

data.name: Akasuna the Battle Ashtra
data.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Trap from your hand or face-down field to the GY; change all face-up monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck.

data.name: Alligator's Dragon Knight
data.desc: Can attack directly. You can only use each of the following effects of "Alligator's Dragon Knight" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your hand; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 Spells/Traps with different names that mention "Dark Time Wizard", from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card.

data.name: Angelechy Brilliant Move
data.desc: Return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY, then send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Brilliant Move" once per turn.

data.name: Angelechy Castellan
data.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column, or 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone that is 2 columns away from this card's; banish that card. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can send 1 "Angelechy" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Castellan" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each player can only activate 1 card or effect per Chain.

data.name: Angelechy Endgame Problem
data.desc:
This card gains the following effects, based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 1+: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: You can draw 1 card.
● 2+: When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s), you choose the zone(s) to place it.
● 3+: Once per turn, you can activate 1 "Angelechy" Trap Card the turn it was Set.
● 4+: Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish that monster(s).
● 5: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck.

data.name: Angelechy Opposition
data.desc: Choose 2 "Angelechy" monsters in your Extra Deck, with different names than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summon 1 of them in your opponent's Main Monster Zone, and place the other in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle up to 5 "Angelechy" cards into the Deck from your GY and/or banishment, except "Angelechy Opposition". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Angelechy Opposition" per turn.

data.name: Angelechy Seneschal
data.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 Fairy Synchro Monster from their Extra Deck (but negate its effects), also this card, and monsters Special Summoned by this effect, cannot be used as material for an Xyz or Link Summon, and return them to the Extra Deck when they leave the field. If an "Angelechy" monster targets this card for an attack: Negate that attack, and if you do, give control of this card to your opponent. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Seneschal" once per turn.

data.name: Angelechy Strategy Score
data.desc: Add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Strategy Score", also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Strategy Score" once per turn.

data.name: Angelechy Verdict
data.desc:
Apply this effect based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards on the field.
● 1 to 4: Negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls.
● 5+: Banish all cards your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then you can place 1 "Angelechy" monster with a different name than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Verdict" once per turn.

data.name: Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer
data.desc:
2 WATER monsters
You can send 1 card you control to the GY; all WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF this turn. If a WATER Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those destroyed monsters; Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand or GY, with a Level less than or equal to that monster's Link Rating. You can only use each effect of "Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer" once per turn.

data.name: Ars Magna "Citrinitas"
data.desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage", "DoomZ", and "Elfnote" card.)
While you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster, you can activate the effects of monsters you control with "Ars Magna" in their original names, as Quick Effects. Once, while this card is face-up on the field, during your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Medius" or "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna "Citrinitas"" once per turn.

data.name: Ars Magna "Philosophorum"
data.desc: Target up to 3 "Ars Magna" monsters in your field or GY; banish them, then until the end of this turn, you can negate the effects of up to that many other face-up cards on the field. You can banish this card from your GY; return 1 "Power Patron" Link Monster from your GY to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use 1 "Ars Magna "Philosophorum"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

data.name: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
data.desc: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 "Ars Magna" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, also until the end of the next turn, the first three times each "Power Patron" Link Monster you control would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed. If an Xyz or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can target Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control; banish them. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification" once per turn.

data.name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
data.desc: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

data.name: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
data.desc: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 non-Warrior "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand, also for the rest of this turn, the original ATK of all "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control become tripled. If a Fusion or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. If you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster: You can target 1 monster on the field; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite" once per turn.

data.name: Ashtra's Domain
data.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/Tuner/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, and your opponent controls no face-down cards: Negate that effect.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Domain" per turn.

data.name: Ashtra's Howl
data.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Spellcaster/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● If you have an "Ashtra" monster in your field or GY: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Howl" per turn.

data.name: Ashtra's Web
data.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Insect/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● Target 1 "Ashtra" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Web" per turn.

data.name: Ashtraja Susanoo
data.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish any number of Traps from your GY; banish that many cards from the field. During the End Phase: You can target up to 2 "Ashtra" monsters and/or "Ashtra" Traps in your GY and/or banishment; add to your hand or Set each card, then if you targeted 2 cards, return this card to the Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ashtraja Susanoo" once per turn.

data.name: Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond
data.desc: You can target any number of face-down cards you control; add "Ashtra" cards from your Deck to your hand, except Field Spells, each with a different name, equal to the number of those face-down cards, then send those face-down cards to the GY. If you control an "Ashtra" monster and a face-down card, and either player Sets a card: You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond" once per turn.

data.name: Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto
data.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Ashtra" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, send 1 card on the field to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto" once per turn. If your opponent activates a monster effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Ashtra" Trap in your GY or banishment, or if 3 or more cards are face-down on the field, you can target any 1 Trap in your GY instead; Set it.

data.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
data.desc: While a monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" is on the field, the Levels of all monsters in both players' hands and on the field are reduced by 1. When you Link Summon a "Daedalus" Link Monster, you can reduce the total number of materials by 1 (from Link Rating and from mentioned materials). If this card is in your GY and you control "Umi": You can place this card face-up on your field. You can only use this effect of "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" once per turn.
data.archetype: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

data.name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
data.desc: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

data.name: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
data.desc:
4 monsters
This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 monsters that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your GY to your zone this card points to, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send all cards on the field to the GY, except "Umi".

data.name: Barian's Hope
data.desc: Special Summon 1 "Umbral Horror" monster or 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster from your hand or GY, then you can make the Levels of all "Umbral Horror" monsters you control the same as 1 "Umbral Horror" monster in your field or GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Number" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck or GY to it. You can only use each effect of "Barian's Hope" once per turn.

data.name: Barian's Seal
data.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, while you control a "CXyz" monster, or a monster with "Number C101" through "Number C107" in its name: Negate that activation, then you can attach 1 monster from the field or either GY to 1 Xyz Monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 2 "Umbral Horror" monsters from your GY. You can only use 1 "Barian's Seal" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

data.name: Barian's Seventh Untopia
data.desc: Neither player can Special Summon from the Extra Deck more than 2 times per turn, except "Number" monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barian's Seventh Untopia" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the End Phase: Each player takes damage equal to the number of Xyz Monsters on the field x 400.

data.name: Bingo!
Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity
data.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. If this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Quick-Play or Ritual Spell; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck or GY. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can make your opponent lose 800 LP, and if you do, this card gains 800 ATK.

data.name: Blitzclique Overvolt
data.desc: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Blitzclique Overvolt" once per turn.

data.name: Call of Atlantis
data.desc: Add 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, then if you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", you can negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn. If you control "Umi": You can banish this card from your GY; WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each effect of "Call of Atlantis" once per turn.
data.archetype: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

data.name: Cartoon Shade
data.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) while a monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set is face-up on the field. You can only Special Summon "Cartoon Shade" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck to your hand. If this card on the field is Tributed: You can target 1 card on the field, or target 2 if you control a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF; return them to the hand.

data.name: Chaospawn Bishop
data.desc: If this card you control would be used as Synchro Material, you can treat it as a non-Tuner. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaospawn Bishop" from your hand, Deck, or GY, and if you do, it becomes LIGHT, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon, except LIGHT or DARK monsters, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Chaospawn Bishop" once per turn.

data.name: Clown Crew Cappello
data.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
During your Main Phase: You can send 1 non-Pendulum "Clown Crew" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also until the end of the next turn after this effect resolves, you cannot activate the effect of monsters Special Summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Clown Crew Cappello" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
Monsters your opponent controls lose 1500 DEF while you control a Tribute Summoned monster. If this card is Tributed: You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Cappello" once per turn);
● Shuffle all Pendulum Monsters from the face-up Extra Decks and the field into the Deck.
● Special Summon 1 non-Pendulum "Clown Crew" monster from your Deck or Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.
data.pend_desc: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 non-Pendulum "Clown Crew" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also until the end of the next turn after this effect resolves, you cannot activate the effect of monsters Special Summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Clown Crew Cappello" once per turn.

data.name: Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon
data.desc: While you control "Umi", your opponent cannot target WATER Link Monsters you control with card effects. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can reveal this card and 1 WATER monster in your hand; Special Summon both, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. You can only use this effect of "Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon" once per turn.

data.name: Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse
data.desc:
Send the top cards of your Deck to the GY, up to the number of Traps with different names from each other in the GYs +1 (max. 4), then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 monster from among those cards.
● Set 1 Spell/Trap from among those cards, except "Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse". If you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn.

data.name: Crowned Siclavee
data.desc:
2 Level 3 monsters
Cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon. Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Crowned Siclavee" by using 1 Beast monster you control with 2000 or less ATK (transfer its materials). If this card destroys a monster by battle: Place 1 Crown Counter on this card, then apply this effect based on the number of Crown Counters on this card.
● 1: It gains 400 ATK. ● 2: It gains 600 ATK. ● 3: Return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, draw 3 cards.

data.name: CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon
data.desc:
3+ Level 7 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using 1 monster you control with "Number C101" through "Number C107" in its name (transfer its materials). Gains 1000 ATK for each material attached to it. While this card has a "Number C" monster as material, cards cannot be added from the Main Deck to your opponent's hand except by drawing them. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; attach the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to this card.

data.name: Daedalus Maelstrom
data.desc: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s), while you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s), then if you control a WATER Link Monster, you can destroy all monsters on the field, except WATER monsters. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use 1 "Daedalus Maelstrom" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

data.name: Dark City at Midnight
data.desc: Each time you Special Summon a Level 8 or higher "Destiny HERO" monster(s): Warrior monsters you control gain 300 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dark City at Midnight" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster or 1 card that mentions a "Destiny HERO" monster by name from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck (this is treated as a Special Summon with "Clock Tower Prison").

data.name: Dark Time Wizard
Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma
data.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 3 Warrior and/or DARK monsters from your GY. You can only Special Summon "Destiny HERO - Destro-Dogma" once per turn this way. If Summoned this way: You can activate this effect; during the next Standby Phase, inflict 2000 damage to your opponent. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Warrior or DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck.

data.name: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord
data.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it until the next Standby Phase. You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY; add 1 "Clock Tower Prison" or "Dark City at Midnight" from your Deck or GY to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK "HERO" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord" once per turn.

data.name: Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Master
data.desc:
2 Level 5 or higher "Destiny HERO" monsters
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 "Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster". You can only Special Summon "Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Master" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, that are "Destiny HERO" monsters and/or mention a "Destiny HERO" monster by name. This card's ATK becomes the total original ATK of other "Destiny HERO" monsters in your field and GY.

data.name: Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant
data.desc: If you control a "Destiny HERO" monster or a face-up Field Spell: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can destroy 1 card you control, and if you do, add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. If you Special Summon a Level 8 "Destiny HERO" monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place it on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant" once per turn.

data.name: Elemental Saga Doriado
data.desc: If this card is in your hand, and you have 3 or more different Attributes among the monsters in your GY: You can target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon both it and this card. If you have 3 or more different Attributes among the monsters in your GY: You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with a different Attribute from the monsters in your field or GY. You can only use each effect of "Elemental Saga Doriado" once per turn, also neither player can activate cards or effects in response to either of these effect activations.

data.name: Father Grizzly
data.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with 1400 ATK from your Deck, or if you have 2 or more Level 4 monsters with 1400 ATK in your GY, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster instead. When your opponent activates a monster effect, while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use this effect of "Father Grizzly" once per turn.

data.name: Fisherman of Legend
data.desc: If your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, or when an opponent's monster declares an attack, and "Umi" or a card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" (except "Fisherman of Legend") is on the field (except during the Damage Step): Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it, also during the End Phase of this turn, return this card from the field to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Fisherman of Legend" once per turn.

data.name: Foolish Graverobber
data.desc:
Send 1 card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY, except "Foolish Graverobber", then you can Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field. You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 of the following cards to your field.
● Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your GY, except "Foolish Graverobber"
● Spell/Trap in your opponent's GY
You can only use each effect of "Foolish Graverobber" once per turn.

data.name: Garbage Golem
data.desc: If you control a monster with 0 ATK or DEF: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can reveal 3 Xyz Monsters in your Extra Deck with different Ranks, then target 1 other card on the field; destroy both it and this card. You can banish this card from your GY; detach 1 material from a monster you control, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with 0 ATK or DEF from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Garbage Golem" once per turn.

data.name: Gorgonic Umbral Horror
data.desc: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Number" Xyz Monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gorgonic Umbral Horror" once per turn. If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Umbral Horror" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, add 1 non-Rock "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials.

data.name: Graceful & Skull Dice
data.desc:
Roll a six-sided die twice, and apply these effects for the rest of this turn.
● All monsters you control that mention "Dark Time Wizard" gain ATK/DEF equal to the total x 200.
● All monsters your opponent controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the total x 200.
If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those monsters; roll a six-sided die twice, and if the total was 6 or higher, destroy that monster.

data.name: Half Slice of Nickeline
data.desc: If this card is Special Summoned from the Deck: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Rock monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Half Slice of Nickeline". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Rock monster. You can only use each effect of "Half Slice of Nickeline" once per turn.

data.name: Helping Robo for Underwater Combat
data.desc:
2 Machine monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that monster, also this card, then you can Special Summon 1 non-WATER Machine monster with 1600 or less ATK from your GY. If this card is banished: You can add 1 Machine monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helping Robo for Underwater Combat" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Machine monsters.

data.name: Hey, Space Trunade!
data.desc: Return up to 2 cards from the field to the hand, then each player places cards from their hand on the bottom of their Deck, in any order, equal to the number returned to their hand. You can only activate 1 "Hey, Space Trunade!" per turn.

data.name: Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers
data.desc: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Level 6 or higher Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Hubrow, Founder of the Ominous Observers", then you can add 1 Level 6 or higher Zombie monster from your GY to your hand. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the GY, while this card is in the Monster Zone, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Zombie Xyz Monster.

data.name: Invocation - "Grail"
data.desc:
If you have an "Aleister" monster in your field, GY, or banishment: Activate 1 of these effects;
● Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing 1 monster in your hand or field and 1 monster in your Deck as material.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing 1 monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls as material.
You can only activate 1 "Invocation - "Grail"" per turn.

data.name: Invoked De Anima
data.desc:
1 "Aleister" monster + 1 monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck
If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
When your opponent activates a card effect in the GY (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and if you do, negate that activated effect. You can only use each effect of "Invoked De Anima" once per turn.

data.name: Jinzo - Energy Shocker
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Jinzo" while on the field or in the GY. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can destroy all Traps your opponent controls (if face-down, reveal it), then this card gains 300 ATK for each card destroyed. You can only use this effect of "Jinzo - Energy Shocker" once per turn. While you have another monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your field or GY, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards or effects.

data.name: Just Flip a Coin
data.desc:
If a face-up card(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster from your GY. If you call it wrong, Set 1 Trap from your GY. If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● Set 1 Trap from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Just Flip a Coin" once per turn.

data.name: Kerolia the Frolicsome
data.desc: If a Spell/Trap(s) on the field is returned to the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when that card was returned) or hand (even if not), in face-up or face-down Defense Position, but if you Summoned it from the GY, banish it when it leaves the field. If another card(s) on the field is returned to the hand, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of your banished Normal Traps; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Kerolia the Frolicsome" once per turn.

data.name: Kumenyo, the Nine-Hued Deer
data.desc:
2+ Level 4 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; attach 1 card from your hand, GY, or banishment to this card, except the detached material. You can only use this effect of "Kumenyo, the Nine-Hued Deer" once per turn. Gains the following effects, based on the number of different Monster Types attached to it.
● 2+: Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
● 3+: Draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase.

data.name: Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra
data.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra" once per turn. You can target 1 card on the field for every 2 face-down cards on the field; destroy it. During your End Phase: You can target 1 "Ashtra" Trap in your GY; Set it.

data.name: Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus" once per turn. If you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" or "Umi": You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 3 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; add that many cards that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, except Level 7 monsters, then you can send 1 card on the field to the GY.

data.name: Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus
data.desc:
3 WATER monsters
This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; discard your opponent's entire hand, and if you do, they draw the same number of cards. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation.

data.name: Long-Tailed Black Horse
data.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal 1 Zombie monster in your hand and send 1 EARTH Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY; send the revealed monster to the GY, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Long-Tailed Black Horse" once per turn.

data.name: Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron
data.desc:
2+ monsters, including a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster
Gains these effects based on the number of monsters it points to.
● 1+: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, also until the end of this turn, their ATK become halved.
● 2+: Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects.
● 3: Once per opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card, also all cards your opponent controls.

data.name: Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra
data.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 non-Wyrm "Ashtra" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material for an "Ashtra" Synchro Monster: You can target 1 Normal Trap in your GY; Set it.

data.name: Monster Arms of Atlantis
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Monster Arms of Atlantis" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position. data.name: Ms. Tick Call
data.desc: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can discard 1 other Spellcaster monster or 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish 1 Level 4 Spellcaster monster from your Deck, and if you do, during the End Phase of this turn, add to your hand or Special Summon that banished monster. You can only use each effect of "Ms. Tick Call" once per turn.

data.name: Myriaday Dragon
data.desc: Once per turn, during the End Phase: You can pay 100 LP; place 1 Myriaday Counter on this card. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can place 1 Myriaday Counter on this card for every 1000 points difference between your LP and your opponent's. Gains 10000 ATK/DEF while this card has 10 or more Myriaday Counters. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, remove 1 Myriaday Counter from this card instead.

data.name: Number 104: Masquerade V
data.desc:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Barian's" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the following effect of "Number 104: Masquerade V" once per turn. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as material gains this effect.
● If this card is Xyz Summoned: Activate this effect; your opponent can banish 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck. If they did not, you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.

data.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory
data.desc:
4 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. If this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that opponent's monster's ATK or DEF (whichever is higher) +100, during that damage calculation only. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the GY, and if you do, halve your opponent's LP.

data.name: Predaplant Daredevil
data.desc:
1 "Predaplant" monster + 1 Level 1 monster
Must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 monster on either field with a Predator Counter and 1 "Predaplant" monster you control. During the Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn (Quick Effect): You can target Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of monsters with a Predator Counter; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Daredevil" once per turn.

data.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed
data.desc:
"Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard"
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 face-up monster on either field during the turn a monster was destroyed by the effect of "Dark Time Wizard". You can only Special Summon "Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell or monster effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower monster from your hand or GY.

data.name: Revenge of the Paper Dolls
data.desc: Target 1 monster you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy your monster, and if you do, negate the effects of that opponent's card until the end of this turn. If this Set card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Revenge of the Paper Dolls" once per turn.

data.name: Reversal Box
data.desc: Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die, and place counters on this card (max. 6), up to the result. When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, or once per battle, during damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks: You can remove 1 counter from this card, then target 1 of those monsters; toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck, and if you do, until the end of this turn, change the targeted monster's ATK to 0, also negate its effects.

data.name: Sacred Beasts Skyfall
data.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your "Sacred Beast" monster's effect activation: Negate that effect.
● Reveal 1 Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand; discard 1 card, and if you do, add 1 "Illusion Gate" from your Deck to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 "Sacred Beast" Traps from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Beasts Skyfall" per turn.

data.name: Shining Umbral Horror
data.desc: If you Normal or Special Summon an "Umbral Horror" monster(s) or a "Masquerade" Xyz Monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card, then you can Special Summon it if it is an "Umbral Horror" monster. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials. You can only use each effect of "Shining Umbral Horror" once per turn.

data.name: Siren Vortex of Atlantis
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Siren Vortex of Atlantis" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 card that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to the GY, except "Siren Vortex of Atlantis". If this card is sent to the GY and you control "Umi": You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand.

data.name: Skyborne Blue Cularsaw
data.desc:
1 Level 8 or higher DARK monster + 1 Warrior monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can equip 1 Warrior monster from your GY or banishment, or 1 monster from your opponent's GY or banishment, to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK/DEF. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Skyborne Blue Cularsaw" once per turn.

data.name: Sleepy Scapegoats
data.desc: Special Summon up to 4 "Sacrificial Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position (they cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon this turn), then if your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Swiftwind Panther Warrior" from your Deck, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters. If a card(s) you control that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Token you control that was Special Summoned by this effect instead.

data.name: Spell Power Attainment
data.desc:
Add 1 card that mentions "Spell Counter" in its effect text from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Spell Power Attainment", then if you control a Level 7 or higher "Endymion" Monster Card, you can apply this effect.
● Remove any number of Spell Counters from your field, and if you do, negate the effects of that many face-up cards your opponent controls, and if you do that, destroy those cards.
You can only activate 1 "Spell Power Attainment" per turn.

data.name: Spell Shattering Sword
data.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy all face-up Spells your opponent controls.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; show 1 "Light and Darkness Ritual" in your hand or GY, then that monster's ATK becomes 0, also its effects are negated.
 If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can destroy 1 card in your opponent's hand (at random) or their field. You can only activate 1 "Spell Shattering Sword" per turn.

data.name: Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino
data.desc:
2 monsters, including a Dinosaur monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can make this card gain ATK equal to half the combined original ATK of the Dinosaur monsters used as Link Material. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Dinosaur Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your field or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Dinosaur monsters. You can only use this effect of "Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino" once per turn.

data.name: Swiftwind Panther Warrior
data.desc:
Cannot declare an attack unless a monster was Tributed this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other monster from your hand or field, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your hand or Deck, except "Swiftwind Panther Warrior".
● Send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY.
You can only use this effect of "Swiftwind Panther Warrior" once per turn.

data.name: The Great Gallant Bandit
data.desc: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing monsters in your hand and/or your opponent's field, while you control no monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Great Gallant Bandit" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card effect in the hand, GY, or banishment, and you control this Normal Summoned/Set card (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal your entire hand; change all monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position.

data.name: Theorealized Medius
data.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Power Patron" card.)
If a "Power Patron" card is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "Theorealize" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If a monster is banished face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Ars Magna" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Banish this card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Diactorus" monster from your Extra Deck.
You can only use each effect of "Theorealized Medius" once per turn.

data.name: Thousand Umbral Horror
data.desc: (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "Barian's Seventh Untopia" from your hand or Deck, face-up in your Field Zone, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck until the end of your next turn after this effect resolves, except Xyz Monsters. If an Xyz Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, also you take no effect damage from your card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Thousand Umbral Horror" once per turn.

data.name: Tigress in Silent Repose
data.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

data.name: V Umbral Horror
data.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "V Umbral Horror". You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster you control, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials). You can only use each effect of "V Umbral Horror" once per turn.

data.name: Verre, the Maid of Endymion
data.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Witchcrafter" card.)
Gains 2300 ATK while you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Verre, the Maid of Endymion" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card or effect was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap or 1 "Magical Dimension" from your Deck to your hand.

data.name: Warchief of Atlantis
data.desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Warchief of Atlantis" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. If you control "Umi" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card.

data.name: Yoa the Plague Ashtra
data.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn.
